SELECT T1.School, T1.Street, T1.DOCType
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.`Enrollment (K-12)` - T2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 30
AND T2.FRPMCount (K-12) - T2.FRPMCount (Ages 5-17) > 0

SELECT T1.School, T1.AvgScrMath, T1.FundingType
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.AdmFName1 = 'Ricci' AND T2.AdmLName1 = 'Ulrich'
AND T1.AvgScrMath > 400

SELECT T1.Phone FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds WHERE T2.AvgScrRead = ( SELECT MIN(AvgScrRead) FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T2.County = 'Fresno' ) AND T1.County = 'Fresno'

SELECT 
  T1.SchoolName, 
  T2.AvgScrWrite, 
  T2.NumTstTakr, 
  T2.NumGE1500, 
  T2.FRPMCount, 
  T2.FRPMCount / T2.NumTstTakr AS AverageScoreInWriting, 
  T2.NumTstTakr, 
  T2.NumGE1500, 
  T2.FRPMCount / T2.NumGE1500 AS AverageScoreInWritingWithTSTakers, 
  T2.NumGE1500, 
  T2.FRPMCount / T2.NumGE1500 AS AverageScoreInWritingWithTSTakers, 
  T2.NumTstTakr, 
  T2.NumGE1500, 
  T2.FRPMCount / T2.NumGE1500 AS AverageScoreInWritingWithTSTakers, 
  T2.NumTstTakr, 
  T2.NumGE1500, 
  T2.FRPMCount / T2.NumGE1500 AS AverageScoreInWritingWithTSTakers, 
  T2.NumTstTakr, 
  T2.NumGE1500, 
  T2.FRPMCount / T2.NumGE1500 AS AverageScoreInWritingWithTSTakers, 
  T2.NumTstTakr, 
  T2.NumGE1500, 
  T2.FRPMCount

SELECT T2.Street, T2.City, T2.State, T2.Zip
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2
ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY CAST(T1.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / T1.NumTstTakr ASC
LIMIT 7

SELECT T2.SOC, COUNT(T1.NumTstTakr) AS NumEnroll
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.District = 'California'
GROUP BY T2.SOC
ORDER BY NumEnroll DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.name, T1.format
FROM cards AS T1
INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid
WHERE T2.format = 'commander' AND T2.status = 'Legal' AND T1.name IN (
  SELECT T2.format
  FROM cards AS T2
  INNER JOIN legalities AS T3 ON T2.uuid = T3.uuid
  WHERE T3.format = 'hour of devastation'
)

SELECT T1.name 
FROM cards AS T1 
JOIN foreign_data AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid 
WHERE T2.type = 'Creature' AND T2.layout = 'normal' AND T2.borderColor = 'black' AND T2.artist = 'Matthew D. Wilson' 
AND T2.availability = 'paper' AND T2.availability = 'mtgo' AND T2.frameVersion = 2003 AND T2.isFoilOnly = 0

SELECT DISTINCT T1.type, T1.subtypes, T1.supertypes 
FROM sets AS T1 
JOIN set_translations AS T2 ON T1.setCode = T2.setCode 
WHERE T1.type = 'Creature — Human Cleric' 
AND T1.supertypes != 'Creature — Human Cleric' 
AND T1.subtypes != 'Human'

SELECT COUNT(id) 
FROM cards 
WHERE originalType = 'Summon - Angel' 
AND subtypes != 'Angel'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.id)
FROM cards AS T1
INNER JOIN set_translations AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.id
WHERE T2.setCode = 'Coldsnap'
AND T1.power IS NOT NULL
AND T1.power = '*'
AND T1.convertManaCost > 5

SELECT T2.language 
FROM sets AS T1 
INNER JOIN set_translations AS T2 
ON T1.code = T2.setCode 
WHERE T1.mcmName = 'Angel of Mercy'

SELECT COUNT(T1.id) 
FROM sets AS T1 
INNER JOIN set_translations AS T2 ON T2.setCode = T1.code 
WHERE T2.language = 'Italian' AND T1.block = 'Ice Age' AND T1.baseSetSize < 100

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.id) 
FROM cards AS T1 
INNER JOIN rulings AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid 
WHERE T1.type = 'Pre-Monster' AND T2.text LIKE '%This is a triggered mana ability%' AND T1.side IS NULL
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.colorIndicator = 'U' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.id) FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN foreign_data AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid WHERE T1.isStorySpotlight = 1

SELECT COUNT(T1.id) 
FROM sets AS T1 
INNER JOIN set_translations AS T2 ON T1.code = T2.setCode 
WHERE T1.block = 'Ravnica' AND T1.baseSetSize = 180

SELECT T1.name
FROM cards AS T1
INNER JOIN foreign_data AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid
WHERE T1.originalType = 'Artifact' AND T1.colors = 'B' AND T2.language = 'Spanish'

SELECT T1.OwnerUserId, T1.DisplayName
FROM users AS T1
INNER JOIN badges AS T2
ON T1.Id = T2.UserId
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.CreationDate) = '2010'
ORDER BY T2.FavoriteCount DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT T1.DisplayName FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN votes AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.PostId INNER JOIN users AS T3 ON T3.Id = T2.UserId WHERE T2.BountyAmount = 50 AND T1.Title LIKE '%variance%'

SELECT IIF(T2.FavoriteCount IS NULL, '0', T2.FavoriteCount) AS resylt FROM comments AS T1 INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.PostId = T2.Id WHERE T1.UserId = 3025 AND T1.CreationDate = '2014/4/23 20:29:39.0'

SELECT T1.TagName 
FROM tags AS T1 
INNER JOIN posts AS T2 ON T1.ExcerptPostId = T2.Id 
WHERE T2.CommentCount = 0 AND T2.Score = 0

SELECT T2.DisplayName, T1.Reputation
FROM posts AS T1
INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T2.Id
WHERE T1.Title LIKE '%Understanding what Dassault iSight is doing%'
SELECT T1.ViewCount FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN postHistory AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.PostId WHERE T1.Title = 'Integration of Weka and/or RapidMiner into Informatica PowerCenter/Developer'

SELECT T1.Body
FROM posts AS T1
JOIN tags AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.ExcerptPostId
WHERE T2.TagName = 'bayesian'
SELECT T2.DisplayName FROM votes AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T2 ON T1.UserId = T2.Id WHERE T1.Id = 6347
SELECT Text FROM comments WHERE Score = 17
SELECT T2.DisplayName FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN votes AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.PostId INNER JOIN users AS T3 ON T3.Id = T2.UserId WHERE T2.BountyAmount = 50 AND T1.Title LIKE '%variance%'

SELECT 
  T1.Segment,
  T1.Segment,
  T1.Segment,
  CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'SME', T2.Consumption, 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) - 
  CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'LAM', T2.Consumption, 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) , 
  CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'LAM', T2.Consumption, 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) - 
  CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'KAM', T2.Consumption, 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) , 
  CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'KAM', T2.Consumption, 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) - 
  CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'SME', T2.Consumption, 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) 
FROM 
  customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID 
WHERE 
  T1.Currency = 'EUR' AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201201 And 201312 
GROUP BY 
  T1.Segment 
ORDER BY 
  T

SELECT T3.Description 
FROM transactions_1k AS T1 
INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID 
INNER JOIN gasstations AS T3 ON T1.GasStationID = T3.GasStationID 
WHERE T2.Date = '201306'

SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T1.Segment = 'SME', T2.Consumption, 0)) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) AS avg_consumption_sme
FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
WHERE T1.Currency = 'CZK' AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
AND T1.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')

SELECT DISTINCT T3.`Country` FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID INNER JOIN customers AS T3 ON T1.CustomerID = T3.CustomerID WHERE T1.Date = '2012-08-24' AND T1.Time = '16:25:00'

SELECT DISTINCT T3.Currency
FROM transactions_1k AS T1
INNER JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID
INNER JOIN customers AS T3 ON T1.CustomerID = T3.CustomerID
WHERE T1.Date = '2012-08-24' AND T1.Time = '16:25:00'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Currency = 'CZK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Difference
FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN customers AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T2.Currency = 'CZK'

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN t1.player_name = 'Landon Donovan' THEN t2.overall_rating ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 - SUM(CASE WHEN t1.player_name = 'Jordan Bowery' THEN t2.overall_rating ELSE 0 END)) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN t1.player_name = 'Jordan Bowery' THEN t2.overall_rating ELSE 0 END) FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id WHERE t1.player_name = 'Landon Donovan' AND t2.overall_rating > t2.overall_rating AND t2.overall_rating > 0

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN preferred_foot = 'left' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(player_fifa_api_id) * 100 AS percentage
FROM Player_Attributes AS t1
INNER JOIN Player AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id
WHERE t2.player_name = 'Ahmed Samir Farag'
AND t2.birthday BETWEEN '1987' AND '1992'

SELECT t1.name
FROM League AS t1
INNER JOIN Match AS t2 ON t1.id = t2.league_id
WHERE t2.season = '2010/2011'
GROUP BY t1.name
HAVING (CAST(SUM(t2.home_team_goal) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT t2.id)) - (CAST(SUM(t2.away_team_goal) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT t2.id)) > 0

SELECT t1.player_name, AVG(t1.heading_accuracy) AS avg_heading_accuracy
FROM Player_Attributes AS t1
JOIN Player AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id
WHERE t2.height > 180
GROUP BY t1.player_name
ORDER BY avg_heading_accuracy DESC
LIMIT 10
SELECT AVG(T1.overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes AS T1 INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.player_name = 'Pietro Marino'

SELECT t2.buildUpPlaySpeedClass 
FROM Team AS t1 INNER JOIN Team_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.team_api_id = t2.team_api_id 
WHERE t1.team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge' AND t2.`date` LIKE '2010-02-22%'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t2.player_name) 
FROM Player_Attributes AS t1 
INNER JOIN Player AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id 
WHERE t2.preferred_foot = 'left' AND t1.defensive_work_rate = 'low'
SELECT t1.team_fifa_api_id FROM Team_Attributes AS t1 INNER JOIN Team AS t2 ON t1.team_api_id = t2.team_api_id WHERE t1.buildUpPlaySpeed > 50 AND t1.buildUpPlaySpeed < 60

SELECT CAST(SUM(t2.overall_rating) AS REAL) / COUNT(t2.id) 
FROM Player_Attributes AS t2 
INNER JOIN Player AS t1 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id 
WHERE t1.player_name = 'Gabriel Tamas' AND STRFTIME('%Y',t2.`date`) = '2011'

SELECT player_api_id 
FROM Player_Attributes 
WHERE date LIKE '%1970%' AND date LIKE '%October%'

SELECT 
  district_id AS district, 
  district_name AS region, 
  municipality AS municipality, 
  A6 AS A7, 
  A8 AS A9, 
  A10 AS A11, 
  A12 AS A13, 
  A14 AS A14, 
  A15 AS A16, 
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(account_id) AS percentage_of_accounts_still_running_with_no_issue
FROM loan
WHERE amount < 100000
GROUP BY district_id, district_name, municipality, A6, A7, A8, A9, A10, A11, A12, A13, A14, A15, A16

SELECT T3.account_id FROM client AS T1 INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1.district_id = T2.district_id INNER JOIN account AS T3 ON T2.district_id = T3.district_id INNER JOIN disp AS T4 ON T1.client_id = T4.client_id AND T4.account_id = T3.account_id WHERE T1.gender = 'F' ORDER BY T1.birth_date ASC, T2.A11 DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.account_id, T1.amount, T1.date
FROM loan AS T1
INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.date) = '1997'
AND T2.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
AND T1.duration > 12
ORDER BY T1.amount DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(account_id) FROM loan WHERE amount < 100000
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(account_id) FROM loan WHERE amount < 100000
SELECT T1.district_id FROM client AS T1 INNER JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.account_id WHERE T1.gender = 'F' AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.district_id) = '1976/1/29'

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.time IS NOT NULL THEN T2.driverId END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T2.driverId) 
FROM races AS T1 INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T2.raceId = T1.raceId 
WHERE T1.date BETWEEN '2007-07-01' AND '2009-07-31' 
AND T2.time IS NOT NULL

SELECT T1.name 
FROM drivers T1 
JOIN results T2 ON T1.driverId = T2.driverId 
JOIN races T3 ON T2.raceId = T3.raceId 
WHERE T2.position = 1 
AND T2.positionOrder = 1 
AND T2.points = ( SELECT MAX(points) FROM results ) 
AND T2.laps = 1 
AND T2.time = ( SELECT MIN(time) FROM results WHERE position = 1 AND rank = 1 ) 
AND T2.fastestLap = 1 
AND T2.fastestLapSpeed = ( SELECT MAX(fastestLapSpeed) FROM results WHERE position = 1 AND rank = 1 ) 
AND T2.fastestLapTime = ( SELECT MIN(fastestLapTime) FROM results WHERE position = 1 AND rank = 1 ) 
AND T3.name = ( SELECT T1.name FROM drivers T1 WHERE T1.forename = 'Lewis' AND T1.surname = 'Hamilton' ) 
AND T3.name = ( SELECT T1.name FROM drivers T1 WHERE T1.forename = 'Lewis' AND T1.surname = 'Hamilton' ) 
AND T3.name = ( SELECT T1.name FROM drivers T1 WHERE T1.forename = 'Lewis' AND T1.surname = 'Hamilton' ) 
AND T3.name = ( SELECT T1.name FROM drivers T1 WHERE

SELECT T3.forename, T3.surname, T2.points, T2.name
FROM races AS T1
INNER JOIN driverStandings AS T2 ON T2.raceId = T1.raceId
INNER JOIN drivers AS T3 ON T3.driverId = T2.driverId
ORDER BY T2.points DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.name FROM races AS T1 INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId WHERE T2.position = 1 AND T2.driverId = ( SELECT driverId FROM drivers WHERE forename = 'Lewis' AND surname = 'Hamilton' ) AND T1.year = 2008

SELECT T1.forename, T1.surname 
FROM drivers AS T1 
INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId 
WHERE T2.time IS NOT NULL 
AND T2.raceId = 2008 
AND T2.statusId = 1 
ORDER BY T1.dob DESC 
LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.forename, T1.surname 
FROM drivers AS T1 
INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T2.driverId = T1.driverId 
WHERE T2.time IS NOT NULL 
AND T2.raceId = 592 
ORDER BY T1.dob DESC 
LIMIT 1

SELECT r.name, rr.points
FROM races r
JOIN results rr ON r.raceId = rr.raceId
JOIN drivers dr ON rr.driverId = dr.driverId
WHERE rr.position = 1 AND dr.forename = 'Lewis' AND dr.surname = 'Hamilton'

SELECT T1.lat, T1.lng, T2.name AS location 
FROM circuits AS T1 
INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T2.circuitID = T1.circuitId 
WHERE T2.name = 'Austria'
SELECT T1.lat, T1.lng FROM circuits AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T2.circuitID = T1.circuitId WHERE T2.name = 'Australian Grand Prix'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.driverRef) 
FROM races AS T1 INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T2.raceId = T1.raceId 
WHERE T1.name = 'Bahrain Grand Prix' AND T2.time IS NOT NULL
SELECT T1.lat, T1.lng FROM circuits AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T2.circuitID = T1.circuitId WHERE T2.name = 'Silverstone Circuit'
SELECT code FROM drivers WHERE nationality = 'American'

SELECT T3.forename, T3.surname, T3.driverRef
FROM races AS T1
INNER JOIN results AS T2 ON T2.raceId = T1.raceId
INNER JOIN drivers AS T3 ON T3.driverId = T2.driverId
WHERE T1.name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit' AND T2.rank = 1 AND T1.year = 2007

SELECT DISTINCT T3.first_name, T3.last_name, T3.phone, T1.expense_description, T1.cost
FROM expense AS T1
INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.link_to_budget = T2.budget_id
INNER JOIN member AS T3 ON T3.member_id = T1.link_to_member
WHERE T1.expense_description = 'Water, Veggie tray, supplies'
AND T1.cost > ( SELECT AVG(T1.cost) FROM expense AS T1
                INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.link_to_budget = T2.budget_id
                INNER JOIN member AS T3 ON T3.member_id = T1.link_to_member )

SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name
FROM member AS T1
INNER JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member
WHERE T2.link_to_event IN (
  SELECT event_id
  FROM event
  GROUP BY event_id
  HAVING COUNT(event_id) > 10
)
AND T2.type = 'Meeting'

SELECT first_name, last_name, department, college 
FROM member 
WHERE major_name = 'Environmental Engineering' 
AND department = (SELECT department FROM major WHERE major_name = 'Environmental Engineering') 
AND college = (SELECT college FROM major WHERE major_name = 'Environmental Engineering')

SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name 
FROM member AS T1 
INNER JOIN zip_code AS T2 ON T1.zip = T2.zip_code 
WHERE T2.state = 'Illinois' 
AND T1.department = 'School of Applied Sciences, Technology and Education'

SELECT T1.type, SUM(T3.cost) FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event INNER JOIN expense AS T3 ON T2.budget_id = T3.link_to_budget WHERE T1.event_name = 'September Speaker'

SELECT T2.first_name, T2.last_name, T1.cost
FROM expense AS T1
INNER JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.link_to_member = T2.member_id
WHERE T1.cost > ( SELECT AVG(T1.cost) FROM expense AS T1
                INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.link_to_budget = T2.budget_id
                INNER JOIN member AS T3 ON T3.member_id = T1.link_to_member )
SELECT DISTINCT T2.city FROM zip_code AS T1 INNER JOIN zip_code AS T2 ON T1.zip_code = T2.zip_code WHERE T1.type = 'Standard' AND T1.state = 'Virginia' AND T2.county = 'Orange County'

SELECT T1.event_name, T1.cost FROM budget AS T1 INNER JOIN expense AS T2 ON T1.budget_id = T2.link_to_budget WHERE T2.cost = (SELECT MIN(cost) FROM budget AS T1 INNER JOIN expense AS T2 ON T1.budget_id = T2.link_to_budget)

SELECT COUNT(T1.member_id) 
FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN major AS T2 ON T1.link_to_major = T2.major_id 
WHERE T2.major_name = 'Physics Teaching'

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T3.colour = 'Blue' THEN T1.id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.id) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN gender AS T2 ON T1.gender_id = T2.id INNER JOIN colour AS T3 ON T1.skin_colour_id = T3.id WHERE T2.gender = 'Female' AND T1.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'

SELECT T1.eye_colour_id, T1.hair_colour_id, T1.skin_colour_id
FROM superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T2.id = T1.publisher_id
INNER JOIN gender AS T3 ON T3.id = T1.gender_id
WHERE T2.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics'
AND T3.gender = 'Female'
ORDER BY T1.attribute_value DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id WHERE T3.power_name = 'Death Touch' ORDER BY T1.superhero_name
SELECT T2.gender FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN gender AS T2 ON T1.gender_id = T2.id WHERE T1.power_name = 'Phoenix Force'
SELECT T2.publisher_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN publisher AS T2 ON T1.publisher_id = T2.id WHERE T1.superhero_name IN ('Hawkman', 'Karate Kid', 'Speedy')

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.gender_id = 1 THEN T1.id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.id) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN gender AS T2 ON T1.gender_id = T2.id INNER JOIN colour AS T3 ON T1.skin_colour_id = T3.id WHERE T2.gender = 'Female'

SELECT T1.full_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id INNER JOIN attribute AS T3 ON T2.attribute_id = T3.id WHERE T3.attribute_name = 'Speed' ORDER BY T2.attribute_value DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT T1.eye_colour_id FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id WHERE T1.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan'
SELECT T1.superhero_name FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN colour AS T2 ON T1.eye_colour_id = T2.id AND T1.hair_colour_id = T2.id WHERE T2.colour = 'Amber'

SELECT AVG(T1.weight_kg) FROM superhero AS T1 INNER JOIN gender AS T2 ON T2.id = T1.gender_id WHERE T2.gender = 'Female' AND T1.publisher_id = (SELECT id FROM publisher WHERE publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.CPK > 250 AND T2.PT < 14

SELECT T1.Diagnosis, 
       COUNT(T1.Diagnosis) AS num_patients_lower_than_normal,
       COUNT(T1.Diagnosis) AS num_patients_higher_than_normal,
       (COUNT(T1.Diagnosis) - COUNT(T1.Diagnosis) OVER (PARTITION BY T1.Diagnosis ORDER BY COUNT(T1.Diagnosis) OVER (PARTITION BY T1.Diagnosis) >= 400)) AS num_patients_lower_than_normal,
       (COUNT(T1.Diagnosis) - COUNT(T1.Diagnosis) OVER (PARTITION BY T1.Diagnosis ORDER BY COUNT(T1.Diagnosis) OVER (PARTITION BY T1.Diagnosis) <= 100)) AS num_patients_higher_than_normal
FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.IGM NOT BETWEEN 40 AND 400
GROUP BY T1.Diagnosis
SELECT T1.Birthday FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5 AND T1.BirthYear - T2.BirthYear < 70

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 1 AND T2.`T-BIL` > 2.0 AND T2.`T-CHO` > 250
AND T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.RVVT = '-'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND T1.Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND T1.Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis 
FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.GPT > 60 ORDER BY T1.Birthday ASC

SELECT T1.ID, T1.Birthday, T1.`Examination Date`, T2.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.HGB = ( SELECT MAX(HGB) FROM Patient AS T3 JOIN Laboratory AS T4 ON T3.ID = T4.ID WHERE T3.Birthday <= T1.`Examination Date` )

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE' 
AND T2.HGB >= 10 AND T2.HGB <= 17 
ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC 
LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX , STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) 
FROM Patient AS T1 
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID 
WHERE T2.UN BETWEEN 29 AND 30

SELECT T1.element
FROM atom AS T1
INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.bond_type = '='
SELECT DISTINCT T.element FROM atom AS T WHERE T.molecule_id = 'TR004'

SELECT AVG(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN element = 'f' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(molecule_id)) FROM molecule AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id INNER JOIN atom AS T3 ON T2.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id WHERE T1.label = '+' AND T3.element = 'f'

SELECT T1.element, T2.label
FROM atom AS T1
INNER JOIN molecule AS T2
ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T2.label = '+' AND T1.element = 'h' AND LENGTH(T1.atom_id) = 7

SELECT T3.label, COUNT(T1.bond_type) AS double_bond_count
FROM bond AS T1
INNER JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
INNER JOIN molecule AS T3 ON T3.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id
WHERE T1.bond_type = ' = '
GROUP BY T3.label
ORDER BY double_bond_count DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT T2.label FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE SUBSTR(T1.atom_id, -1) = '21' AND SUBSTR(T1.atom_id, -2) = '25' AND LENGTH(T1.atom_id) = 7

SELECT T1.bond_type, T1.atom_id, T1.atom_id2 
FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id2 
INNER JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id 
WHERE T3.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9'
